records.original_english_definition: Food made from flour and baked.
records.original_burmese_meaning: ပေါင်မုန့်
records.source_supported_grammar_observation: Bread is a mass noun in this food sense; count loaves or slices, not breads for ordinary portions.
records.proposed_original_example_UNAPPROVED: We bought two loaves of bread for the picnic.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: ပေါင်မုန့်ကို အရေအတွက်ဖော်ပြရာတွင် a loaf of bread သို့မဟုတ် a slice of bread ဟု သုံးနိုင်သည်။

records.original_english_definition: Facts or details that help someone understand something.
records.original_burmese_meaning: သတင်းအချက်အလက်၊ သိရှိရန်အချက်အလက်
records.original_example_sentence: The notice gives information about the new bus route.
records.source_supported_grammar_observation: Information is uncountable; not an information or informations. A piece of information is countable.
records.proposed_original_example_UNAPPROVED: The receptionist gave us a piece of information about the bus timetable.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: information ကို uncountable noun အဖြစ် သုံးပြီး အချက်တစ်ချက်ကို a piece of information ဟု ဖော်ပြနိုင်သည်။

records.original_english_definition: Information collected for study or use.
records.original_burmese_meaning: စုဆောင်းထားသော အချက်အလက်များ
records.original_example_sentence: The team checked the data before writing the report.
records.source_supported_grammar_observation: Oxford records uncountable and plural use: in technical English data can take plural agreement; avoid rigid singular-only or plural-only rule.
records.proposed_original_example_UNAPPROVED: The researchers compared the data from two surveys.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: data ကို ယေဘုယျသုံးစွဲမှုတွင် uncountable အဖြစ်လည်း၊ နည်းပညာစာရေးသားမှုတွင် plural အဖြစ်လည်း သုံးနိုင်သည်။

records.original_english_definition: The public service whose officers enforce the law and protect people.
records.original_example_sentence: The police asked drivers to use another road.
records.source_supported_grammar_observation: Police referring to the organisation/officers is grammatically plural; the police are, not the police is.
records.proposed_original_example_UNAPPROVED: The police are investigating the reported theft.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: the police ကို ရဲတပ်ဖွဲ့/ရဲအရာရှိများအဖြစ် သုံးလျှင် plural verb နှင့်တွဲသုံးသည်။

records.original_english_definition: New information about events happening now or recently.
records.original_burmese_meaning: သတင်း၊ နောက်ဆုံးဖြစ်ရပ်အကြောင်းအရာ
records.original_example_sentence: We heard the news on the radio this morning.
records.source_supported_grammar_observation: News is uncountable and takes a singular verb despite final -s; not the news are.
records.proposed_original_example_UNAPPROVED: The news is encouraging this morning.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: news သည် -s ဖြင့်ဆုံးသော်လည်း singular verb နှင့်တွဲသုံးရသော uncountable noun ဖြစ်သည်။

records.original_english_definition: Knowledge or skill gained by doing something.
records.original_burmese_meaning: အတွေ့အကြုံ
records.original_example_sentence: He has experience working in a small shop.
records.source_supported_grammar_observation: The frozen skill/knowledge sense is uncountable; a particular event is countable. Do not substitute event meaning.
records.proposed_original_example_UNAPPROVED: She has several years of experience in warehouse operations.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: အလုပ်လုပ်ကိုင်၍ရရှိသည့် အတွေ့အကြုံသည် uncountable ဖြစ်ပြီး သီးခြားကြုံတွေ့မှုတစ်ခုကို an experience ဟု သုံးနိုင်သည်။

records.original_english_definition: A careful examination of information to understand it.
records.original_burmese_meaning: အသေးစိတ် ခွဲခြမ်းစိတ်ဖြာလေ့လာမှု
records.original_example_sentence: The team completed an analysis of the survey results.
records.source_supported_grammar_observation: Oxford marks the study/result sense both countable and uncountable; plural is analyses, not analysises; do not treat topic badge as headword CEFR.
records.proposed_original_example_UNAPPROVED: The report includes an analysis of the results.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: analysis ကို ရေတွက်နိုင်/မရေတွက်နိုင် နှစ်မျိုးသုံးနိုင်ပြီး plural သည် analyses ဖြစ်သည်။

records.original_english_definition: Suggestions about what someone should do.
records.original_example_sentence: She gave me useful advice about the interview.
records.source_supported_grammar_observation: Advice is uncountable; some advice or a piece of advice, not an advice.
records.proposed_original_example_UNAPPROVED: The trainer offered some practical advice.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: advice ကို uncountable noun အဖြစ် သုံးပြီး အကြံပြုချက်တစ်ခုကို a piece of advice ဟု ဖော်ပြနိုင်သည်။

records.original_english_definition: The tools or machines needed for a particular activity.
records.original_burmese_meaning: ကိရိယာပစ္စည်းများ၊ အသုံးအဆောင်စက်ပစ္စည်းများ
records.original_example_sentence: The team checked its safety equipment before entering the site.
records.source_supported_grammar_observation: Equipment is uncountable; count items or pieces, not equipments.
records.proposed_original_example_UNAPPROVED: The laboratory needs two new pieces of equipment.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: equipment ကို uncountable noun အဖြစ် သုံးပြီး ပစ္စည်းအရေအတွက်ကို pieces of equipment ဟု ဖော်ပြနိုင်သည်။

records.original_burmese_meaning: လမ်းပေါ်ရှိ ယာဉ်အသွားအလာ
records.source_supported_grammar_observation: Traffic in road-vehicle sense is uncountable; a traffic is not idiomatic, and traffic jams count separate events.
records.proposed_original_example_UNAPPROVED: Heavy traffic is slowing the delivery vehicles.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: ယာဉ်အသွားအလာအဓိပ္ပာယ်ရှိသော traffic သည် uncountable ဖြစ်ပြီး ပိတ်ဆို့မှုတစ်ခုကို a traffic jam ဟု ခွဲဖော်ပြသည်။

records.original_english_definition: Movement towards a better or more complete result.
records.original_burmese_meaning: တိုးတက်မှု
records.original_example_sentence: The students made good progress this term.
records.source_supported_grammar_observation: Progress meaning advancement is normally uncountable; make progress, not a progress or progresses for ordinary improvement.
records.proposed_original_example_UNAPPROVED: The students have made steady progress.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: တိုးတက်မှုအဓိပ္ပာယ်ရှိသော progress ကို uncountable noun အဖြစ် သုံးပြီး make progress ဟု တွဲသုံးသည်။

records.original_english_definition: The identification of an illness or problem through examination.
records.original_burmese_meaning: ရောဂါ သို့မဟုတ် ပြဿနာကို စစ်ဆေးဖော်ထုတ်သတ်မှတ်ခြင်း
records.original_example_sentence: An early diagnosis can help doctors plan treatment.
records.source_supported_grammar_observation: Oxford marks the illness/problem identification sense countable and uncountable; plural diagnoses, not diagnosises; healthcare c1 is a topic badge, not independent exact-sense CEFR evidence.
records.proposed_original_example_UNAPPROVED: The doctor confirmed the diagnosis after further tests.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: diagnosis ကို countable/uncountable နှစ်မျိုးသုံးနိုင်ပြီး plural သည် diagnoses ဖြစ်သည်။
